description: Fetch a URL. If it answers 402 with an x402 offer that takes Fusebox payments (scheme "fusebox" on X Layer, in USDT0), the price is paid from the Fusebox wallet 0x0Db0457715a6445D8a65F820d717a6B39Be66800 only if every fuse allows it, then the request is retried with the proof and the response comes back. A refused price moves nothing. It pays at most max_price (default 0.10 USDT0 when you don't set one), only to public hosts. Use dry_run to see the price and the fuses' answer without paying. Without FUSEBOX_AGENT_KEY it behaves as a dry run.

content_type.description: Content-Type for the body, default application/json

dry_run.description: Only report the price and what the fuses would say

max_price.description: Most you'll pay for this call, in USDT0, e.g. "0.05". Default 0.10

name: fusebox_fetch
title: Fetch a URL, paying for it through the fuses if it asks (x402)
